title: EATF Action Evidence Package toolkit
description: Open toolkit for creating, inspecting, and offline-verifying Action Evidence Packages (.aep): a hybrid RSA-4096 plus ML-DSA-65 signer, two verifiers (TypeScript and Python), both built by Tyche Institute, sign/verify/inspect CLIs, RFC 9881 public-key encoding, JSON schemas, positive and negative conformance vectors, and a deterministic offline downgrade lab.
notes: Version 0.7.4 makes the legacy RSA check of the two verifiers (TypeScript and Python, both built by Tyche Institute) exact, and has both read public_key.pem, metadata.json and the base64 signature entries by one rule. After a strict RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 failure, v0.7.3 and earlier compared only the trailing 32 bytes of the recovered block with the SHA-256 digest; the fallback now requires the whole block to equal the one encoding the Java reference signer produces (a SHA-256 DigestInfo with absent parameters), and the report names it. Four test vectors are re-signed in the RFC 8017 form, so strict implementations accept the three valid ones. Both verifiers now require public_key.pem to be one PEM block labelled PUBLIC KEY holding an RSA SubjectPublicKeyInfo with nothing after it and compare signer pins on that DER; they read metadata.json as UTF-8 without a byte order mark, with no member name repeated within one object, no NaN or Infinity literal and at most 64 nested levels; and they read signature.sig and overt_receipt.sig by the signature_pqc.sig base64 rule. Abdel Fane (OpenA2A) found the RSA issue with an independent second verifier built from the documents, and docs/aep-format.md answers the questions from his table that the implementation settles. docs/authority-record-v1-scope.md now states that the frozen corpus's time-stamp tokens are over RSA signature values. The 5 accepted and 8 rejected conformance vectors, the 42 lab observations and the 21 decision-path cases give the same results as in v0.7.3. Version DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.24263970. Previous version v0.7.3 is doi:10.5281/zenodo.23552715 under concept doi:10.5281/zenodo.21763055; releases through v0.5.0 remain under earlier concept doi:10.5281/zenodo.21511608.
